title: Produce Traceability Log Form
subtitle: Produce Traceability record recurring events, evidence, variances, review decisions, escalation, and accountable period closeout in one operational record.
description: An original, workflow-complete produce traceability operating log covering identity and routing, domain observations and evidence, accountable decisions, exceptions and escalation, and completion handoff without replacing qualified judgment.
use_case: Use for a defined operating period when staff need repeatable entries, traceable observations, visible exceptions, and a reviewed handoff. The record is owned by the produce traceability owner and closes only after evidence, exceptions, disposition, and the next accountable handoff are documented.

sections.title: Produce Traceability log routing
sections.guidance: Define the period, owner, subject, and controlling identifiers.

blocks.label: Operating Log identity and routing
blocks.guidance: Assign one owner and use the same record ID in attachments and follow-up.

blocks.label: Produce Lot Or Tracking Event identity
blocks.guidance: Preserve the identifiers used by the controlling farm, facility, or partner record.

sections.title: Produce Traceability operating context
sections.guidance: Capture the baseline needed to interpret recurring entries.

blocks.label: Entry readiness and record controls
items: Produce description, variety, quantity, and unit were recorded
Traceability lot code and code-source location were captured
Tracking event type, date, time, and location were captured
Immediate previous source or next recipient was identified
Reference document type and number were linked
Transformation, repacking, or commingling links were preserved
Corrections retain the original record and responsible person
Held, recalled, or unreconciled lots remain visible
blocks.guidance: Use these confirmations at the start of the log period and revisit changed conditions.

sections.title: Produce Traceability recurring entries
sections.guidance: Record each event with enough evidence to reconstruct what occurred.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability event log
blocks.guidance: Use one row per distinct event; continue under a linked record when more rows are needed.

blocks.label: Trend, context, and supporting evidence notes

fields.label: Produce Traceability trend and evidence detail

sections.title: Produce Traceability period review and decision
sections.guidance: Review completeness, trends, and work that cannot be closed.

blocks.label: Review evidence
items: Produce Traceability entries, dates, and identifiers reconcile
Trends and abnormal events are supported by recorded evidence
Open exceptions have an owner and due point
Restrictions or holds are visible to the next operator
Qualified review was obtained where the controlling procedure requires it

blocks.label: Decision rationale, trend interpretation, and next action

sections.title: Produce Traceability exceptions and escalation
sections.guidance: Make incomplete or abnormal events visible until disposition.

blocks.label: Stop, hold, and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This original worksheet supports trace investigation but does not determine regulatory coverage or authorize a hold, release, or recall. A qualified owner must apply the current traceability plan and applicable requirements, preserve record history, and escalate any gap affecting lot identity or disposition.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability exception triggers
items: Lot code, code source, or product identity is missing
Quantity, unit, split, or transformation does not reconcile
Event date, location, source, or recipient is missing
Reference document or system link cannot be retrieved
Label, case, pallet, invoice, or shipment mismatch
Held, recalled, corrected, or commingled lot remains unresolved
blocks.guidance: Mark each applicable trigger and explain any uncertainty in the exception record.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability unresolved-event register
blocks.guidance: Do not close a row until its disposition and accountable owner are explicit.

sections.title: Produce Traceability log closeout and handoff
sections.guidance: Reconcile the period and transfer remaining work.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability open actions and limitations
blocks.guidance: Carry forward every item that is not fully resolved at closeout.

blocks.label: Produce Traceability handoff confirmations
items: Produce Traceability entries and period totals were reconciled
Corrections and exception records retain accountable owners
Restrictions, holds, or service needs were transferred
Next log period or review point was assigned
Source records and supporting evidence were filed
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items remain part of the open handoff.

blocks.label: Final outcome, remaining limits, communications, and acceptance notes
